verdict.rationale: Supabase ships and documents an official MCP server (docs and hosted endpoint), with runtime probes confirming the live hosted MCP endpoint at mcp.supabase.com speaks the MCP OAuth flow, plus official agent skills bundles and BYO MCP guides. Community discussion raises security concerns (prompt injection risk) but does not dispute that the MCP server exists and functions as documented. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of successful agent task completion via the MCP server beyond the security incident discussion.
